readme.html:
simcraft

Skills that teach Claude how to do hard things well.

24 skills for Claude Code, built from real projects, with the parts tutorials skip.

Install · Video · Engineering · Learning · Design · Planning


Each skill is a folder with a SKILL.md: the method, the judgement calls, and real, tested scripts for one kind of work. Claude Code loads the right one when your request matches. You don't call them by name, you just ask.

What makes them different: every skill covers what breaks, how to check the result, and how to tell good from good enough.


Install

git clone https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft ~/simcraft
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
for s in ~/simcraft/skills/*/*/; do ln -s "${s%/}" ~/.claude/skills/; done
cd ~/simcraft && npm i

Then open Claude Code and ask for something, like "make a perspective-illusion loop of a rainy night street".

More setup details
  • Claude Code finds skills one folder deep, so the loop links each one into ~/.claude/skills. The categories are only for browsing. To install a single skill, link just that folder.
  • A few skills have a one-time setup script in their folder (for example setup.sh for Whisper in rough-cut). Each SKILL.md says so at the top.
  • Needs: Python 3.9+, Node 18+ (for skills that drive a browser or render video), and ffmpeg on your PATH or set as FFMPEG=/path/to/ffmpeg.
  • API keys (only image-gen uses them) are read from your environment or ~/.config/simcraft/keys.env. They never go in the repo.

Skills

🎬 Video

Skill What it does
perspective-illusion Illustrated 3D loops in the Japanese perspective-illusion style: flat scenes that open into depth.
code-loop Any three.js scene or shader rendered as a seamless loop, checked for seams, freezes and blinks.
reverse-engineer-video Hand it a viral clip, get a remake plan: every cut, camera move and beat.
scripted-screencast Product demos written as a script and rendered frame-perfect. No retakes.
repo-timelapse Your git history as a video of the project growing.
rough-cut Raw talking footage to a tight first cut: pauses, ums and retakes removed.
clean-audio Voice cleanup that measures first, then keeps every word clear.
vox-explainer Vox-style explainer graphics timed word by word to a voiceover.

🧑‍💻 Engineering

Skill What it does
codebase-map Learn an unfamiliar repo fast by tracing one real request end to end.
bisect-anything Find the exact commit behind any regression, then the exact lines.
flaky-test-killer Fix why a test is flaky, never with retries, and prove the fix.
benchmark-honestly Benchmarks that survive scrutiny, with confidence intervals.
api-design-review Review an API, SDK or CLI, and catch breaking changes.
security-threat-model Threat-model your own app from its real code, LLM apps included.
dx-audit Try a developer tool like a brand-new user and time it to first success.

🧠 Learning

Skill What it does
paper-to-runnable A research paper turned into the smallest honest implementation of its idea.
system-design-from-scratch Build a tiny real system, load-test it, break it, write up the trade-offs.
from-scratch Learn anything by building the smallest version of it, one step at a time.
teach-back You explain it, Claude finds the gaps, you get a one-page cheat sheet.

🎨 Design

Skill What it does
image-gen Images with your own Gemini or OpenAI key, consistent across a set.
brand-kit Learn a brand from its live site into a kit the other skills apply.

🧭 Planning

Skill What it does
skill-router Picks the right skill for a task, or a chain of two or three.
next-step A big messy goal turned into one clear next action at a time.
video-script Short video scripts that sound like you, built from your own ramble.

Chains that work well

skill-router builds these on its own when a task has stages.

Start with Then
A viral clip reverse-engineer-video → code-loop or perspective-illusion
A research paper paper-to-runnable → vox-explainer
A new SDK dx-audit → scripted-screencast
"It got slower" benchmark-honestly → bisect-anything
A new job codebase-map → flaky-test-killer
Raw footage rough-cut → clean-audio

Credits

image-gen was inspired by adamd9/skill-image-gen, and vox-explainer by Charlie Hills' vox-animation skill (both MIT). Everything here is written from scratch.
